newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices ease on lower demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices ease on lower demand.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Thursday on lower consumer and retail demand while improved arrivals triggered profittaking by stockists, dealers said.
"Increased offerings by millers due to withdrawal of outstation support led to increased supplies in the local market," a dealer said.
In ready delivery sugar, S-30 fell by 10 rupees to 1,305/1,330 rupees while M-30 slid by five rupees to 1,320/1,375 rupees. Sugar mill delivery also fell by 10 rupees to 1,230/1,240 rupees.
